name: se7enxweb/expqueue
description: The Exponential job queue: a generic, database-backed job queue with priority classes, fair scheduling, per-resource concurrency limits, leases, retries, a dead letter, idempotency, CLI/cron/systemd workers and an admin dashboard

suggest.ext-pcntl: lets a worker finish its current job on SIGTERM/SIGINT before it leaves
suggest.ext-posix: lets workers started as root become the site user
